title: Zesty Spicy Indian Sweetcorn Lassi
description: A spicy and creamy Indian drink featuring sweetcorn, perfect for a sick day pick-me-up, this cheese-pull lassi is egg-free-friendly and made with a mortar-pestle-pound method.
instructions: In a large mortar, pound the sweetcorn with a pestle until it is well crushed and the juices are released.
Add the yogurt, garam masala, cumin powder, cayenne pepper, and salt to the mortar and mix until well combined.
Stir in the honey and lemon juice until the honey is fully dissolved.
Gradually add the water to the mortar and mix until the desired consistency is reached.
Crumble the paneer cheese into the mortar and mix until it is well distributed and the cheese is starting to pull.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Pour the lassi into glasses and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately and enjoy the cheese-pull effect.
You can also refrigerate the lassi for up to 2 hours before serving.
Give the lassi a good stir before serving if it has been refrigerated.
